item.text:
Refactored [Graph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/005_depth_first_search/Graph.java:1) so it’s now an immutable traversal-time graph instead of also being the mutable construction API. The runtime representation is packed into `int[][]`, and mutable edge assembly moved into `Graph.Builder`, which [DepthFirstSearchDemo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/005_depth_first_search/DepthFirstSearchDemo.java:1) now uses.

That gives the codebase a cleaner separation: build the graph once, then traverse a stable snapshot. It also reduces representation overhead in DFS, since neighbor access no longer depends on mutable `List<List<Integer>>` state.

Verification: `javac DepthFirstSearch.java Graph.java IntGraph.java DepthFirstSearchDemo.java` succeeds, and `java DepthFirstSearchDemo` prints `0 3 2 1 4 5`.
